## Statement

$$ \forall n \in \mathbb{N},\; n < 2^n $$

## Hypotheses

- **H1.** $n$ ranges over the naturals.

## Why it was raised

The weak bound is not enough for the step that consumes it.

## Current notes

Worked to budget at S1 without settlement, so the entry is open.
